title: Fictive and Example (2022)
headline: No defect was found in Theorems 1 and 2. The proof of the Exit Lemma skips a case; the authors agreed and supplied a short argument that closes it.

claims.label: Theorem 1
claims.gist: The bundle clock ends at a Walrasian price whenever one exists.
claims.statement: If a Walrasian equilibrium exists, the ascending bundle clock terminates at a Walrasian price vector.

result.summary: No counterexample among the auctions checked; the proof read line by line.
result.search_scope: Up to three bidders and four goods with integer valuations up to six. The proof read line by line.
result.limits: Larger auctions rest on the proof.

vor_check.detail: Statement, definitions and the decisive step checked on rendered pages of the published version.

checks.detail: A separate AI session reran the search independently.

reproduction.detail: The evidence package reruns with one command (Python 3.12, standard library only).

claims.label: Theorem 2
claims.gist: Truthful bidding is an ex post equilibrium of the clock.
claims.statement: Under the conditions of Theorem 1, truthful bidding is an ex post equilibrium of the bundle clock.

result.summary: No profitable deviation found in any auction checked.
result.search_scope: Same auctions as Theorem 1; all single-bidder deviations.
result.limits: Larger auctions rest on the proof.

vor_check.detail: Statement, definitions and the decisive step checked on rendered pages of the published version.

checks.detail: A separate AI session reran the search independently.

claims.label: Exit Lemma
claims.gist: A bidder who exits never re-enters at a higher price.
claims.statement: Along every run of the clock, a bidder who drops out of a bundle does not bid on it again at a higher price.
claims.quantifiers: along every run of the clock

result.summary: The proof omits re-entry after a tie between bundles; a short argument closes it.
result.witness: The proof's induction does not treat rounds that follow a tie between two bundles. No counterexample to the lemma exists in the cases checked, and the authors' added argument handles the tie case.
result.tested: The proof read line by line; all runs in auctions with up to three bidders checked.
not_claimed: The Exit Lemma is not claimed to be false.
Theorems 1 and 2 are not affected once the gap is closed.
result.repair_note: The authors supplied a short argument for the tie case; the researcher checked it.
